answers.core:
Yes, this must be core because:

Export system integration - error reporting happens during the core export process
C# compilation pipeline - requires access to internal compilation errors
Platform detection - needs engine-level knowledge of platform capabilities
Universal benefit - affects all C# developers doing cross-platform exports
Cannot be externally implemented - plugins don't have access to compilation error details

This is a fundamental quality-of-life improvement for the engine's error reporting system.
answers.workaround:
This cannot be worked around with script - it's a core engine/export system issue.
Current workarounds require:

Trial-and-error debugging to identify the problematic namespace
Knowledge of conditional compilation techniques
Understanding of platform-specific limitations
Time-consuming process of elimination

The enhancement improves the core developer experience and reduces the learning curve for cross-platform C# development in Godot.

title: Improve error messages for platform-specific C# compilation failures
